Permutation Test for Directional Transition Asymmetry

Source: R/stats.R
permutation_transition_test.Rd

Tests whether label1 -> label2 transitions are more frequent than label2 -> label1 by comparing the observed directional asymmetry score (n1 - n2) against a null distribution generated by randomly shuffling event labels within each session many times. This controls for both the base rates of each event type and the temporal structure of the recording.

Usage

permutation_transition_test(
  data,
  label1,
  label2,
  window_sec = 120,
  n_perm = 1000L,
  label_col = "vocalization_label",
  start_col = "session_relative_start",
  end_col = "session_relative_end",
  session_col = "session_label",
  require_adjacent = TRUE,
  seed = 42L,
  plot = TRUE
)

Arguments

data

A data frame of vocalization events (e.g., lys$vocalization_session_map).

label1

Character. First label (the hypothesised trigger).

label2

Character. Second label (the hypothesised response).

window_sec

Numeric. Matching window passed to compute_onset_latency(). Default 120.

n_perm

Integer. Number of permutation iterations. Default 1000.

label_col

Character. Column holding the event label. Default "vocalization_label".

start_col

Character. Column holding event start time. Default "session_relative_start".

end_col

Character. Column holding event end time. Default "session_relative_end".

session_col

Character. Grouping column for sessions. Default "session_label".

require_adjacent

Logical. Passed to compute_onset_latency(). Default TRUE.

seed

Integer or NULL. Random seed for reproducibility. Default 42.

plot

Logical. If TRUE (default), draw a histogram of the null distribution with the observed statistic marked.

Value

Invisibly, a list with:

observed

Observed asymmetry score (n1 - n2).

null_distribution

Numeric vector of permuted scores.

p_value

One-sided p-value: proportion of permuted scores \(\geq\) observed.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
res <- permutation_transition_test(
  data       = lys$vocalization_session_map,
  label1     = "BeggingCall",
  label2     = "SongBout",
  window_sec = 120,
  n_perm     = 2000
)
res$p_value
} # }
